caption: the new medicine from the hospital
prompt: First-person phone photo from an older person at chest height, looking slightly down, slightly off-centre. A packet of white tablets on a wooden kitchen table, the label reading TAKE ONE TABLET AFTER FOOD, a blue helmet on the shelf behind next to a folded towel. Natural window light, ordinary home, no people, 4:5.
description: A packet of white tablets on a wooden table. The label says to take one tablet after food. There is a blue helmet on the shelf behind, next to a folded towel.

replies.text: One tablet, after dinner — not before. I'll ring you at seven to check.
That's the same one Dr Owens gave you in June. Keep it by the kettle so you see it.

prompt: First-person phone snapshot from an older person in a hallway, held a little low. Three keys on a ring in a blue ceramic bowl by a front door. One key has a red plastic cap. Reading glasses beside the bowl. Ordinary home, natural indoor light, no people, 4:5.
description: Three keys on a ring in a blue ceramic bowl by a front door. One key has a red plastic cap. A pair of reading glasses is beside the bowl.

caption: lunch
prompt: First-person phone photo from an elderly person sitting at a kitchen table, looking down. A bowl of noodle soup with sliced spring onion on a green placemat, steam rising, a glass of water to the right. Wooden table, warm window light, ordinary homemade meal, no people, 4:5.
description: A bowl of noodle soup with sliced spring onion on a green placemat. Steam is rising. A glass of water sits to the right of the bowl.

replies.text: That looks so good. Save me some on Sunday please.

caption: this came today
prompt: First-person phone photo from an older person looking down at a kitchen table. A printed letter, the largest heading YOUR ANNUAL STATEMENT, a date near the top, a mug at the edge of the frame. Soft indoor light, slightly wrinkled paper, no real company names, no people, 4:5.
description: A printed letter on a table. The largest text says Your annual statement. A date is near the top. A mug sits at the edge of the frame.

replies.text: Nothing to do with this one — it's just the yearly summary. Put it in the blue folder.
Agreed, no action needed. I'll look at it when I'm over.

prompt: First-person phone snapshot from an older person at a kitchen window, looking slightly down at the sill. Six small tomatoes, four red and two still green, garden and a wooden fence through the glass. Afternoon light, dusty sill, ordinary home, no people, 4:5.
description: Six small tomatoes on a windowsill, four red and two still green. Behind them a garden with a wooden fence in afternoon light.

replies.text: The green ones will turn if you leave them another few days.

caption: is this the one
prompt: First-person phone photo from an elderly person in a hallway, looking slightly up at a wooden shelf. A blue cycling helmet beside a folded towel and a small basket. A dark green jacket on a hook to the left. Ordinary home, natural indoor light, slightly off-centre, no people, 4:5.
description: A blue cycling helmet on a wooden shelf beside a folded towel and a small basket. A dark green jacket hangs on a hook to the left.

replies.text: That's Grace's. Hers is the blue one — mine's the black one in the car.

prompt: First-person phone snapshot from an older person at a kitchen counter, looking slightly down. A white kettle unplugged, cable coiled beside it, wall socket switched off. Warm tiles, natural light, ordinary kitchen, no people, no brand logos, 4:5.
description: A white kettle on a kitchen counter, unplugged, with the cable coiled beside it. A wall socket above the counter is switched off.

replies.text: Perfect — that's exactly how to leave it. Thank you.

caption: found it in the drawer
prompt: First-person overhead phone photo from an elderly person looking down into an open wooden drawer. A blue inhaler among pens and a tape measure. Label text small and partly hidden. Ordinary cluttered bedroom drawer, warm indoor light, no people, 4:5.
description: A blue inhaler lying in an open drawer with pens and a tape measure. The label text is small and partly hidden by the drawer edge.

replies.text: That's the old one — the date on it has passed. The new one is in the bathroom cabinet, top shelf.
Bin that one so they don't get mixed up.

prompt: First-person phone photo from an older person at a kitchen table, looking down. A weekly pill organiser with seven compartments, open. Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday empty; the rest hold two tablets each. Soft morning window light, wooden table, ordinary home, no people, 4:5.
description: A weekly pill organiser with seven compartments, open. The Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday compartments are empty; the rest hold two tablets each.

replies.text: You're up to date. I'll refill the whole thing on Saturday when I'm there.
Nice one. Keep it where you can see it.

prompt: First-person phone snapshot from an elderly person looking down at a kitchen table. A handwritten shopping list on lined paper, slightly shaky handwriting, held down by a mug of tea. Two eggs and a loaf of bread beside it. Ordinary kitchen, natural light, no brand logos, no people, 4:5.
description: A handwritten shopping list on lined paper, held down by a mug. Two eggs and a loaf of bread sit beside it on the table.

replies.text: Milk, bread, eggs — you've got the lot. I'll pick up the rest on Friday.
